**CASTING DO NOWEGO FORMATU TELEWIZYJNEGO**
## **MASZ 18–30 LAT LUB 60-70+? DAMY CI SZANSĘ PRZEŻYĆ COŚ ZUPEŁNIE NOWEGO.**

Powstaje **nowy profesjonalny projekt telewizyjny** oparty na prawdziwych ludziach, autentycznych spotkaniach i sytuacjach, których nie da się do końca zaplanować.

Szukamy **młodych dorosłych w wieku 18–30 lat oraz seniorów 60+/70+ z całej Polski**.

**Wyślij na adres: pascalproduction.lab@gmail.com**

Nie musisz być influencerem, aktorem ani mieć żadnego doświadczenia przed kamerą.

Wręcz przeciwnie — **najbardziej interesuje nas to, jaki/jaka jesteś naprawdę.**

**KOGO SZUKAMY?**

Kobiet i mężczyzn w dwóch grupach wiekowych:

**18–30 LAT**
**60-70+**

Szukamy bardzo różnych osób i bardzo różnych historii.

Możesz studiować, pracować, prowadzić własny biznes, być na emeryturze albo właśnie zastanawiać się, co dalej. Możesz mieszkać w dużym mieście, małej miejscowości albo na wsi.

Możesz kochać sport, podróże, muzykę, ogród, gotowanie, motoryzację, technologię, sztukę, gry, taniec, majsterkowanie, internet albo mieć zainteresowanie, którego kompletnie się nie spodziewamy.

Możesz być duszą towarzystwa albo introwertykiem. Mieć mnóstwo energii albo spokojnie obserwować świat. Mieć za sobą niezwykłą historię albo uważać swoje życie za zupełnie zwyczajne.

**Nie szukamy jednego typu człowieka.**

Najważniejsze, żebyś miał/miała **własną osobowość, ciekawość ludzi i gotowość na nowe doświadczenie.**

**O CO CHODZI?**

Tego na etapie otwartego castingu **nie chcemy jeszcze zdradzać**.

Możemy powiedzieć jedno:

**wybrane osoby zaprosimy do udziału w nietypowym doświadczeniu, w którym liczyć się będą prawdziwi ludzie, ich osobowości, reakcje, emocje i różne sposoby patrzenia na życie.**

Nie jest to casting aktorski. Nie będziesz odgrywać napisanej roli.

Interesuje nas **Twoja prawdziwa osobowość i to, co wydarzy się naprawdę.**

Szczegóły projektu przedstawimy osobom zaproszonym do kolejnego etapu castingu.

**CHCESZ SPRÓBOWAĆ?**

**Wyślij na adres: pascalproduction.lab@gmail.com**
* imię i wiek,
* miejscowość,
* numer telefonu,
* aktualne zdjęcie,
* kilka zdań o sobie i swoich zainteresowaniach,
* link do Instagrama / TikToka — jeśli korzystasz,
* krótki film nagrany telefonem (ok. 1–2 min).

Na filmie odpowiedz po prostu:

**Kim jesteś? Co najbardziej Cię wciąga? Co jest dla Ciebie ważne? I czego jeszcze chciałbyś/chciałabyś w życiu spróbować?**

Nie montuj. Nie przygotowuj przemowy. Nie próbuj być „telewizyjny/a”.

**Telefon, minuta lub dwie i Ty.**

Jeżeli przejdziesz pierwszy etap, skontaktujemy się z Tobą i opowiemy więcej.

A jeśli podczas czytania pomyślałeś/pomyślałaś o **swoim znajomym, przyjacielu, rodzicu, dziadku, babci, wnuku lub wnuczce** — wyślij mu/jej to ogłoszenie.

**Być może właśnie takiej osoby szukamy.**

Lubisz ludzii nowe doświadczenia? MŁODZI DOROSLI 18-30 LAT WEJDŹ NA CHWILĘ DO INNEGO ŚWIATA! Masz pasję, histori ද, poczucie humoru? Chcesz isz wyzwania a nowe sytuacje? zeżyć coś wyjąt wyjątkowego? Masz własne zdanie osobowość? Jesteś gotowy/a na coś nieoczywis vistego? ZGŁOŚ SIĘ! Szczegóły opisie posta. To może być Twoja przygoda! ZGŁOŚ SIĘ! Szczegóły W opisie posta. To może Twớj moment! być PRAWDZIWA HISTORIA MOŻE ZACZYNAĆ SIĘ OD CIEBIE.'

CASTING – Court-métrage "Where Echoes Linger (15min) 

 Lieu de tournage : Les vans, 

📅 fin octobrel (env. 4 jours) 

💡 défrayé : repas + transport

Pitch : Deux chercheurs en son, Miguel et Eva, partent enregistrer les sons d'une forêt — jusqu'à ce que la forêt commence à leur répondre.

Profils recherchés :

Rôles principaux

● MIGUEL (H 25–35) — chercheur en son, peu expressif, méthodique

● EVA (F 25–35) — chercheuse en son, douce, apparence légèrement fragile/pâle

Anglais courant. Une expérience ou un intérêt pour la musique / le sound design est un plus apprécié.

Candidature : 2 photos (portrait et pied à tête) + âge/taille/ville + langues parlées + niveau d'anglais + disponibilités + (CV/lien vidéo optionnel) + téléphone

📩 whereechoeslinger@gmail.com — Objet : CASTING – [RÔLE] – Nom Prénom

CASTING CALL, paid, non-union. Toronto / GTA.

We're a small Canadian home wellness brand shooting a short commercial with a Toronto crew on Aug 29-30 (backup Sept 5-6). Interiors, no travel.

Looking for:

- Mother, 65-75. Speaks to camera, teleprompter provided. One day.

- Daughter, 45-55. Speaks to camera. Two half days.

- Friend, 60-75. No lines. Part day.

We're casting the mother and daughter as a pair. If you know someone who could pass as your mom or your daughter, apply together.

To apply, email ask@silvie.com with your role in the subject line:

- two recent photos, one headshot, one full length

- a 60-second phone video, natural, reading the line on the poster

- your rate, your city, and which weekend you can do

Everyone who sends a tape gets a reply.

* Someone who could naturally read as a working professional / office professional

Mark Your Calendar!!/NOW CASTING both AEA and non-union talent!!
SG Casting is casting The Lone Tree Arts Center’s production of Amadeus in Lone Tree, Colorado!

Both local and non-local talent are encouraged to submit an audition!

AEA audition sign ups will open on Monday, August 17th.

Non-AEA audition sign ups will open on Wednesday, August 26th.

If you are local, please sign up for an in-person audition if possible.  

If you are not local, please plan to submit a video audition. 

The Lone Tree Arts Center’s Executive Director is Leigh Chandler.

LORT D Contract

Weekly Rate:

$950.00 minimum for Principals and Understudies/Swings

Director: Geoffrey Kent

Executive Director: Leigh Chandler

Casting Director: Sylvia Gregory, CSA

All above creative team members will be present at auditions and viewing audition videos.

In Person Initial Auditions: Monday September 14th and Tuesday September 15th.

In Person Callbacks: Monday October 5th; will add Tuesday October 6th if needed.

Video general auditions are due by Friday September 11th..

Video callbacks are due by Friday, October 2nd.

First Rehearsal - 3/16/27

Tech Starts - 3/31/27

Invited Rehearsals - 4/7/27

Opening - 4/8/27

Closing - 4/18/27

General Audition Requirements:

Please prepare one monologue or two contrasting monologues not to exceed 3 minutes total.

For in-person and video auditions:

In person auditions are by appointment only. Sign up, upload headshots and resumes, and/or submit your videos all at this link: 

https://www.lonetreeartscenter.org/amadeusauditions

Headshot and Resume are REQUIRED to be uploaded into Production Tools.

Do not contact members of the production teams. If you have any questions, contact Saundra Bergman at Saundra.Bergman@cityoflonetree.com.

The Lone Tree Arts Center is committed to diversity and maintains a policy of equal employment opportunity designed to promote a positive model of inclusion. As such, we encourage performers of all ethnicities, gender identities, body types and sizes, and ages, as well as performers with disabilities, to audition for appropriate roles.

The Lone Tree Arts Center creates a safe and equitable workplace through policies defined by the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, the Actors’ Equity Association, and the City of Lone Tree. These policies provide a comprehensive framework for health and safety of all actors, stage managers, creative staff, and designers employed by The Lone Tree Arts Center.

Information and Character Breakdown

CASTING NOTE:

Antonio Salieri and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart will be cast with male-presenting performers. Constanze Weber will be cast with a female-identifying performer, as the character is pregnant at one point in the play. 

All other roles are open to performers of any gender. Performers of all genders and gender expressions are encouraged to audition. 

Character genders, pronouns, relationships, and historical identities will remain as written in the script; performers will not be asked to portray a gender different from their own.

Roles:

ANTONIO SALIERI, male-presenting, 50 to 65

Court Composer to the Emperor. Brilliant, ambitious, and deeply conflicted, he serves as narrator while recounting his lifelong rivalry with Mozart. Exceptional command of language and emotional range required.

WOLFGANG AMADEUS MOZART, male-presenting, 25 to 35

A musical genius with boundless wit, irreverence, and youthful energy. Mercurial, funny, and deeply vulnerable beneath his exuberance.

CONSTANZE WEBER MOZART, female-presenting, 20 to 35 

Mozart’s devoted wife. Intelligent, resilient, and fiercely practical as she struggles to support her husband and family. Role will also include Ensemble work.

EMPEROR JOSEPH II, 35 to 55 

Emperor of Austria. Affable, curious, and genuinely devoted to music, though often unaware of his own limitations. Strong comic instincts. Role will also include Ensemble work.

BARON VAN SWIETEN, 50 to 70 

Influential patron of the arts. Intellectual, dignified, and quietly authoritative. Role will also include Ensemble work.

COUNT VON STRACK, 35 to 60 

Court official. Polished, ambitious, and committed to preserving decorum and tradition. Role will also include Ensemble work.

COUNT ORSINI-ROSENBERG, 40 to 65 

Imperial Director of Opera. Conservative, politically savvy, and skeptical of artistic risk. Role will also include Ensemble work.

BARON WALSEGG, 40 to 65 

Wealthy aristocrat with a mysterious presence. Reserved and imposing. Role will also include Ensemble work.

Two VENTICELLI, 30 to 50 

The “Little Winds.” Nimble storytellers who provide gossip, exposition, and comic energy. Excellent timing and verbal dexterity required.

KATHERINA CAVALIERI, 20 to 40 

Celebrated soprano and former student of Salieri. Confident, poised, and accustomed to admiration. Classical singing ability welcome but not required. (No dialogue). Role will also include Ensemble work.

TERESA SALIERI, 40 to 60 

Salieri’s wife. Quiet, observant presence. (No dialogue). Role will also include Ensemble work.

ENSEMBLE

18+ To portray courtiers, servants, musicians, clergy, and opera performers. Strong ensemble skills and comfort with multiple roles. Singing and movement abilities a plus.

Jodi Purdy Casting Director sharing for Paul D Head!

Greetings! My name is Paul Head, and I’m a Los Angeles-based non-scripted Casting Director. You can view my credits and credentials at www.pauldhead.com. I’m currently casting a premium documentary series for a major cable network exploring an often-unspoken experience.

We’re looking nationwide for people whose spouse or long-term life partner suddenly and unexpectedly left, vanished, or ghosted them without explanation—including people who are still legally married but don’t know where their husband or wife is. 

We’re specifically seeking people who are not currently in communication with their partner, don’t know where they are, don’t understand why they left, and have been unable to find them on their own.

The series offers expert help in finding answers, gaining clarity, and hopefully getting the closure you’ve been looking for.

This is a paid documentary series featuring real people and real, ongoing situations.

If this sounds like you or someone you know, we’d like to hear from you. We’re casting nationwide now! To apply and for more information: casting@bodegapictures.com

CASTING PAID ROLES FOR SEASON 4 OF OUR ACTING COMPETITION AND THE UPCOMING DARK COMEDY / FANTASY SHORT “PENNY & LANA” — AUSTIN, TX

Please read the full breakdown in the description below before submitting.

——————————————————

Written by Rob Borrego, EP / Creator

Produced & Directed by Sheilava

Logline:

Two middle-aged female fugitives take a mysterious “de-aging pill” in order to escape the law and have one last wild night as young women with a second chance at redemption.

*NOTE: 

This is a non-union, independent production filming in the Greater Austin Area.

ALL TALENT MUST BE BASED IN THE GREATER AUSTIN AREA — this is an Austin-based acting competition and production.  No lodging, transportation, or travel compensation will be provided.

Select Talent will appear in our dark comedy/fantasy short, as well as 1-5 episodes of Season 4 of our YouTube acting competition consisting of four rounds of a recorded callback audition process (see link for a peek at our show: 

https://l.instagram.com/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fyoutu.be%2Fnm2h-dfjwK8%3Fis%3DpIcLl7mOg7UxZ4QK&e=AUB9XmbuRTVX_5zBQU_A5GbpGa4zlMuWDFc7VhuH_BCoq_9-14dRnr0w65ngNGBuMFxUCbpxb1yuL4Hx6u513SqlBY20x1n0VUxmxaiLM4HE_0EgTQANSuU2iQgY

To be considered, all talent must be fully available for our in-person pre-screening Callback round on Friday, August 28 (time slots are scheduled between 10:30 AM - 4:00 PM.

Please do not submit if you cannot be available on this date!

——————————————————

YOUNG PENNY - LEAD, EARLY 20s

FEMALE, BLONDE, CAUCASIAN

The planner, the strategist, and the sharper, drier half of “The Bling Queens.”  She produces the de-aging pills and quietly carries the guilt.

$250/day, meals, IMDb credit

Selected Talent must be fully available during the following production dates:  

September 4, 5, 6, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22.  

*Note: we are scheduled to film late evening scenes on 9/18-9/19 and overnights for exterior nighttime scenes on 9/20-9/22.  

Please do not submit if you cannot be fully available for these dates/times!

——————————————————

YOUNG LANA - LEAD, EARLY 20s

FEMALE, BROWN EYES, DARK HAIR, 
MIXED-RACE / CAUCASIAN PRESENTING

Bubbly, impulsive, and fiercely devoted, Lana is the live-it-up counterweight to Penny’s caution. Her lifelong loyalty to Penny is the friendship our story rests on.

$250/day, meals, IMDb credit

Selected Talent must be fully available during the following production dates:  

September 4, 5, 6, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22.  

*Note: we are scheduled to film late evening scenes on 9/18-9/19 and overnights for exterior nighttime scenes on 9/20-9/22.  

Please do not submit if you cannot be fully available for these dates/times!

——————————————————

JAMES — SUPPORTING, EARLY 40s

MALE, BROWN HAIR, BROWN EYES, CAUCASIAN

James is Andrew’s lifelong friend and partner in their yearly ritual of borrowed youth. He is young at heart, lively, impetuous, and incredibly loyal.

$150/day, meal, IMDb credit, needed for 1 day

*Selected Talent will be needed on 9/19 for an overnight exterior shoot starting no earlier than 7pm. 

——————————————————

***SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS***

Send us an email with the subject line: 

YOUR NAME + CHARACTER NAME

Include the following in your email:

- headshots 
- a recent/candid photo (selfies are ok)
- resume, reels, IMDb, and/or links to previous work 

Send to:

callbackscompetition@gmail.com

——————————————————

DEADLINE TO SUBMIT:  
THURSDAY, AUGUST 20th, 12 PM NOON

COULD YOU BE SANTA? 🎅

We’re looking for Santas across Teesside & the North East to join the Santa’s Coming to Town team for Christmas 2026.

If you’ve got a great beard, a warm personality, a natural Santa presence and genuinely love making Christmas magical, we want to hear from you.

You don’t need to be a professional Santa already - we’ll give you full training, support and everything you need to step into the big red suit with confidence.

- Paid work
- Flexible dates
- Full training
- A fantastic team
- The chance to make unforgettable Christmas memories

This isn’t just dressing up as Santa. It’s bringing Santa to life.

If you think you’ve got what it takes, apply online in just two minutes through our website.

🎅 santascomingtotown.com

Christmas 2026. Could you be our Santa? 🎅

Hi I’m Jane from Beau-Louise Photography an East Midlands Headshot photographer now taking bookings for September & October.

I advise on styling and what outfits work best for each look. Between your own wardrobe and my clothes rail we’ll create the perfect look for each look. I can also help with hairstyles if required. 

With 11 years experience of the industry working alongside Casting directors, Producers, Film makers & Agency owners, I know what is required to create stand out images. I am also Spotlight, Tagmin & Agency approved, I also have an enhanced DBS certificate and Chaperone Licence. 

I am completely transparent with my pricing & packages, what you see is what you pay, no hidden charges.

If anyone knows of any opportunities that would be suitable for him, please do let me know.

items.text:
CASTING CALL FOR TOURING PANTO
Delighted to announce that we are casting for our brand-new touring pantomime, SLEEPING BEAUTY! 👑✨

We’re looking for versatile, energetic performers to join our professional cast for a magical Christmas tour, bringing the pantomime experience directly to primary school audiences across the region 🎭

👑 ROLES AVAILABLE

• Beauty

• Morpeth / Prince

• King

Please note: all roles are multi-role and performers must be confident playing multiple characters throughout the production.

📅 AUDITIONS: 22 September 2026

🎭 REHEARSALS: Late November / early December

✨ TOUR DATES: 4–18 December 2026 (EXACT DATES TBC) 

To be considered and to read our audition information pack, please send your headshot and CV to:

📩 kim@mimictheatre.co.uk

We’re looking for performers with great stage presence, strong comedy skills and the versatility to bring multiple characters to life in a fast-paced touring panto!

Please note, if you are unable to make the audition date, we’d still like to hear from you. 

Deadline to apply: 15th Sept 26

#CastingCall #MimicTheatreCompany #PantomimeCasting #TheatreJobs #touringpanto

I am Thomas Goersch. A filmdirector from Germany.  I am looking for all kind of Actors for my next movie „Just Go – the day I left Kevin Costner“
I am a filmmaker working on Indendent Shortmovies to present on many international filmfestivals all around the word.
You can earn no money with these movies and so do I. The movies I made received about 400 awards and had a good attention.
I am starting next the second shooting part of my my next movie.
The Idea of the movie is:
40 actors are telling one story in a Video Chat. 
Every actor with 2-3 sentences. Every actor is shooting on his own with his smart phone. It would be perfect to have a great mixture from serveral countries.
Please watch at my imdb side to know more about me.
www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Every actor will get a credit on imdb and for sure in the movie. 
Please ask for more informations.
Best Thomas Goersch

Please write to : Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de

🔥 PROMOTER / SALES PERSON WANTED — GERMANY & FRANCE

We are looking for outgoing sales promoters to work with our tattoo team at conventions and events in Germany and France.

Your job:
• Approach visitors and start conversations
• Present our offers and tattoo artists
• Work with objections
• Convert visitors into clients/bookings

We are looking for:
• Strong communication and sales skills
• Confident approaching strangers
• Experience in direct sales, promotion or events is a big advantage
• German + English for Germany
• French + English for France
• Russian/Ukrainian is a bonus, but not required

📍 Work at tattoo conventions and events
💰 Fixed payment + sales bonus
📅 Freelance / weekend projects throughout the year

If interested, send a short introduction, city, languages, sales/event experience and Instagram/LinkedIn or photo in DM.

items.text:
Hi, ich bin **Berhane Berhane**, Comedian, Schauspieler, Entertainer und Moderator aus München. 

Aktuell bin ich auf der Suche nach **neuen Jobs, Castings und spannenden Projekten im Film-, TV-, Werbe- und Entertainmentbereich**.

 **Schauspiel – Deutsch & Englisch**
Meine **Schauspielausbildung habe ich in den USA absolviert** und selbst einige Zeit in **Los Angeles** gelebt. Dadurch kann ich Rollen sowohl **auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch** spielen und bin auch für internationale bzw. englischsprachige Produktionen einsetzbar.

 **Comedy, Moderation & Entertainment**
Als Comedian bringe ich langjährige Bühnenerfahrung, Timing, Improvisation und Spontaneität mit. Zusätzlich werde ich regelmäßig als **Moderator und DJ** für Veranstaltungen gebucht.

 **Action, Kampfsport & Stunts**
Ich habe **Thaiboxen und Kung-Fu** trainiert und kann bei entsprechenden Produktionen auch körperliche Rollen und Stunts selbst übernehmen.

 **Fitness, Tanz & Bewegung**
Durch meine **Trainer-C-Lizenz im Fitness- und Tanzbereich** kann ich ebenfalls für Produktionen eingesetzt werden, bei denen Fitness, Tanz, Bewegung oder Choreografie gefragt sind.

 **Snowboard**
Seit **über 25 Jahren arbeite ich als Snowboardlehrer** und bringe entsprechend viel Erfahrung auf dem Board mit. Damit bin ich auch für Film-, TV-, Werbe- und Actionproduktionen im Wintersportbereich interessant.

**Mein Profil:**
 Schauspiel Deutsch & Englisch
 Comedy & Improvisation
 Moderation & Entertainment
 DJ
 Thaiboxen & Kung-Fu
 Action & Stunts
 Fitness & Tanz
 Über 25 Jahre Erfahrung als Snowboardlehrer

 **Casting-Agenturen, Produktionsfirmen, Regisseure & Veranstalter:**
Wenn ihr für euer nächstes Projekt einen vielseitigen Darsteller und Entertainer sucht, freue ich mich über eure Nachricht. **Ich bin offen für Castings, Drehs, Werbung, TV, Film und neue spannende Projekte.**

Gerne teilen & weiterempfehlen. 

**Berhane Berhane**

items.text:
Have you ever shared so much that you suddenly wondered, “What’s left to say?”
That was me today.

I’ve covered a lot on the Stars in Their Eyes podcast: auditions, agents, scams, contracts, safety, and what it really takes to guide a child through this industry.

So, when I sat down to prepare for today’s recording, I kept asking myself one question:

What do parents need to hear from me next?

For a moment, I had nothing.

Then it came to me.

That look on my face? That’s the exact moment the next episode clicked.

Now it’s time to start writing. ✍🏽

I’m not revealing the topic just yet, but I want to hear your guess. What do you think I’m covering next?

#StarsInTheirEyesPodcast #ParentsofYoungPerformers #ChildActors #YoungModels #EntertainmentIndustry #PodcastBehindTheScenesWarm

items.summary:
Have you ever shared so much that you suddenly wondered, “What’s left to say?”
That was me today.

I’ve covered a lot on the Stars in Their Eyes podcast: auditions, agents, scams, contracts, safety, and what it really takes to guide a child through this industry.

So, when I sat down to prepare for today’s recording, I kept asking myself one question:

What do parents need to hear from me next?

For a moment, I had nothing.

Then it came to me.

That look on my face? That’s the exact moment the next episode clicked.

Now it’s time to start writing. ✍🏽

I’m not revealing the topic just yet, but I want to hear your guess. What do you think I’m covering next?

#StarsInTheirEyesPodcast #ParentsofYoungPerformers #ChildActors #YoungModels #EntertainmentIndustry #PodcastBehindTheScenesWarm

Parents, an audition is about much more than learning the lines and showing up.
Before your child walks into an audition room, you need to understand what they may experience, what questions you should ask, and how to help them handle the process with confidence.

Episode 9 of the Stars in Their Eyes podcast is called “The Truth About Auditions.”

If your child wants to act, please take the time to listen. The more you understand about this industry, the better prepared you’ll be to protect your child and support their dream.

🎧 Listen now wherever you get your podcasts.

[ Warszawa / graffiti / hip-hop / animacja 3D ]
👉 PROJEKT PASJONACKI (NON-PROFIT) 👈

Tworzę 15-minutowy niezależny film animowany osadzony w undergroundowym świecie warszawskiego graffiti. To historia o grupie grafficiarzy, zaufaniu i uprzedzeniach.

🔥 CO WYRÓŻNIA TEN PROJEKT?

To nie jest kolejna fikcyjna opowieść zza biurka. Film powstaje w ścisłej współpracy ze środowiskiem:

✓ W projekcie biorą udział znani polscy grafficiarze, którzy oficjalnie przekazali swoje prawdziwe prace do odwzorowania w świecie 3D.

✓ Warstwę muzyczną stworzą producenci i DJ-e mocno związani ze sceną hip-hopową.

✓ Mamy już gotowy scenariusz, storyboardy, blockouty 3D i animatic (którego fragment widzisz w tym poście!).

👇 ZOBACZ NASZ ANIMATIK (2:30 min) WGRANY BEZPOŚREDNIO DO POSTA! 👇

👤 KOGO SZUKAMY? (4 ROLE GŁOSOWE)

Nie musisz być profesjonalistą. Szukamy ludzi z charakterem i naturalnością.

1️⃣ SCAR (mężczyzna, 24 lata) – charyzmatyczny, energiczny, wyluzowany, kocha ryzyko i adrenalinę.

2️⃣ MROZ (mężczyzna, 25 lat) – spokojny, ostrożny, pewny siebie.

🌟 WAŻNE: Do tej roli szukamy osoby z naturalnym ukraińskim lub białoruskim akcentem!

3️⃣ HUSAR (mężczyzna,  21 lat) – twardy, emocjonalny, bezpośredni. Trenuje sporty walki i maluje graffiti.

4️⃣ GAJA (kobieta, 23 lata) – opanowana, zdystansowana tatuatorka. Ma sarkastyczne poczucie humoru.

🎥 ZAKRES WSPÓŁPRACY (Głos + Referencje wideo)

Szukamy osób z Warszawy lub okolic (lub gotowych na dojazd), ponieważ współpraca obejmuje dwa etapy:

Nagrania dubbingowe w studio.

Krótką sesję nagrań wideo (tzw. video reference) – nagramy Twoją grę aktorską i mimikę na kamerze, aby nasi animatorzy mieli idealną bazę do ożywienia postaci w 3D.

💰 WARUNKI WSPÓŁPRACY

Projekt jest niezależny i tworzony w 100% z zajawki, dlatego współpraca ma charakter NIEODPŁATNY. Oferujemy pełny credit w napisach końcowych oraz unikalne materiały do aktorskiego demo. Szukamy pasjonatów, którzy chcą mieć realny, twórczy wkład w powstawanie bezkompromisowego i autentycznego filmu.

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?

W zgłoszeniu możesz przesłać:

🎙️ krótkie nagranie głosowe z wybranymi kwestiami castingowymi

(próbkę tekstu z materiałem do nagrania znajdziesz w dokumencie w pierwszym komentarzu pod postem)

📁 portfolio / wcześniejsze nagrania — jeśli je posiadasz

📱 Instagram / inne social media — opcjonalnie

Nie potrzebujesz profesjonalnego sprzętu – nagranie próbki z telefonu w cichym pokoju w zupełności wystarczy!

Wszystko wyślij na:

📧 EMAIL: m.krzewskigrafika@gmail.com (lub napisz w wiadomości prywatnej).

Zgłoszenia otwarte do 10.09.2026

👇 LINK DO DOKUMENTU Z TEKSTAMI I SZCZEGÓŁAMI 👇

Szukamy osób z Warszawy lub okolic (lub gotowych na dojazd), ponieważ współpraca obejmuje dwa etapy:

Nagrania dubbingowe w studio.

Krótką sesję nagrań wideo (tzw. video reference) – nagramy Twoją grę aktorską i mimikę na kamerze, aby nasi animatorzy mieli idealną bazę do ożywienia postaci w 3D.

💰 WARUNKI WSPÓŁPRACY

Projekt jest niezależny i tworzony w 100% z zajawki, dlatego współpraca ma charakter NIEODPŁATNY. Oferujemy pełny credit w napisach końcowych oraz unikalne materiały do aktorskiego demo. Szukamy pasjonatów, którzy chcą mieć realny, twórczy wkład w powstawanie bezkompromisowego i autentycznego filmu.

W zgłoszeniu możesz przesłać:

📱 Instagram / inne social media — opcjonalnie

Nie potrzebujesz profesjonalnego sprzętu – nagranie próbki z telefonu w cichym pokoju w zupełności wystarczy!

Wszystko wyślij na:

📧 EMAIL: m.krzewskigrafika@gmail.com (lub napisz w wiadomości prywatnej).

**CASTING CALL Unpaid Student Short Film**

Genre: Sci Fi / Psychological Horror

Logline: NEUROCORP invites you to join the NEUROCORP Lottery, where one winner will have their brain scanned and uploaded into the NEUROCORP database!

CORVIK: A scientist leading NEUROCORP to push the boundaries of mapping Neurons into a machine, effectively being able to copy and paste human consciousness. They do not care about the subject, only about the work being done. Yet they understand the subject isn’t property, a copy of their consciousness is. Corvik is personable, down right charismatic when talking to people, but when talking to a copy of that person's consciousness they are the polar opposite, and looks at that same person as property.

**ANYBODY IS FREE TO CAST. I DO NOT HAVE A DEMOGRAPHIC IN MIND FOR CORVIK ONLY SOMEONE WHO CAN CONVINCE ME THEY ARE CORVIK. **

Shoot will take approximately 2 days, aiming for 1st week of **September! **Shooting will take place in the **Thornton** and** Boulder area. **

This is an 8 page script. If I had to estimate I would say it would take at **most** 4 hours per day (there may be another day for re shoots). We are shooting inside all day and are not rushed by daylight. If you have any questions feel free to email me.

I am **NEVER** on facebook **EMAIL ME** if you're interested!

**EMAIL ME AT:** Cportales60@gmail.com

items.text:
Casting a cyberpunk student film, "ELEVEN"

When green, healthy trees are a luxury hoarded by the ultra-rich, a thief and an android stand at odds on where these million-dollar seeds ought to go.

Shooting will occur in three weeks on the 11th, 12th, and 13th of September at Lowry Studios in Aurora.

Roles needed:

ENPLANTER (female 20-30)

Born with a silver spoon in her mouth. She raises and sells plants like million-dollar racehorses. Entitlement and corporate-speak are the primary emotional elements.

ROBOT78J (male 20-30)

A humanoid robot designed for companionship, cleaning, and admin support. Cold and soft-spoken.

BOBBY (male 30+)

A career criminal, uncomfortable when a plan has too many holes.

Here is the link to audition sign up: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd1NeDp1hfcjSjmXssvkOys5-b2ejBYNCRjIHOw71O-Vm93aw/viewform?usp=header

If there are any questions, feel free to ask in the comments!

🎪 JITO CLOWN — IDENTIDAD VISUAL OFICIAL

Todo gran espectáculo comienza mucho antes de salir a escena.

Como parte del desarrollo integral de su nuevo aparato profesional de cable tenso, creamos para Jito Clown una identidad visual capaz de representar su verdadera esencia: alegría, ingenio, valentía, adrenalina, versatilidad y profesionalismo.

Una imagen concebida para acompañar todo su universo artístico: el aparato, sus cobertores personalizados, el escenario, el vestuario y cada una de sus presentaciones.

Jito Clown combina la tradición del clown clásico con el riesgo y la técnica de las grandes disciplinas circenses.

Un artista. Mil escenarios.

Diseño, creación y desarrollo integral:
Wilfredo Mauricio Triana Villalón

☎️  AUDITION CALL! 

🌻 CALENDAR GIRLS By Tim Firth 🌻

✨ Producer Mike Jewison
✨ Director Dinah Watts
✨ Co-Director Cassandra Allen

📚 ABOUT THE PLAY: 
Calendar Girls is a critically acclaimed, heartwarming comedy-drama based on a true story. It features a group of middle-aged women who pose tastefully nude for a charity calendar to honor a lost loved one. A perfect balance of hilarity, poignant grief, and body positivity. (There are also parts for men and young women.) (This will be fun!!!!)
Full length play in two acts.

📆 AUDITION DATES:
Saturday, October 3 - 1:30 to 4:30 pm
Wednesday, October 7 - 6:30 to 9:30 pm
Friday, October 9 - 6:30 to 9:30 pm
CALL BACKS: Saturday October 17 - 2:00 to 4:00 pm

PERFORMANCE DATES: April 29 to May 9, 2027

REHEARSALS: To start Mid-January, 2027

✅ AUDITION REQUIREMENTS:
Please prepare a 1-2 minute monologue. Keep it short and sassy – and we may ask you to read from the script. NO ACCENTS REQUIRED. If invited to callbacks, you will be asked to read/enact selected sides from the play alongside fellow auditioners.

📩 HOW TO SUBMIT: 
Please visit our Audition page on our website (🔗 in comments) for the full character breakdown, and send your audition request to Dinah at: calendargirlsauditions [at] gmail [dot] com

 #auditions  #atthepalace #LondonOntario #oevldn #castingcall #theatrelondonontario #CalendarGirls

items.text:
Hi everyone! 👋

My name is Redmir Remigio and I'm an aspiring actor/supporting artist based in Guildford, Surrey.

I've been getting more involved in acting and film work recently and have had the opportunity to work on a few professional productions as a supporting artist, including an on-set upgrade which gave me the chance to perform dialogue.

I'm currently building up my experience and credits while continuing to develop my acting skills. I'm particularly interested in TV, feature films, short films, commercials and speaking roles, but I'm also happy to consider supporting artist work that gives me more experience on professional sets.

I'm currently registered with Casting Collective, Uni-versal Extras and Mandy, among a few others.

I'm not on Spotlight yet, but that's definitely something I'm hoping to achieve in the near future as I continue building my credits, training and experience.

A little about me:

Playing age: 25–40
Height: 5'6"
Hair: Black
Eyes: Black
Based: Guildford, Surrey
Happy to travel for the right project

I'm looking forward to connecting with other actors, filmmakers, casting directors and creatives in the group, and hopefully getting involved in some great projects along the way.

Thanks everyone!!

topComments.text: I am near Guildford also actor!

NOBODY has a ‘playing age’ of 25 to 40. That is IMPOSSIBLE. And doing extra work won’t get you a Spotlight Profile. You HAVE to be fully fledged: CAST. Ie: A character that you’ve had to audition for, and have booked.

Hi, I'm Joe and I am 15 and from Manchester! 

I'm a new actor in the industry but have been working on skills and talent behind closed doors through school and self-tapes over the last 5 years.

As an actor, I’d say I am confident, charismatic and have a lot of stage presence. I can sing and fit in with a range of other characters and work well when acting with different groups.

Over time, I've learnt how to empower my skills through thoughts and emotion. Working in acting has always been a dream for me and to get opportunities that can progress my career will add onto how I can work on myself and what prospect there is in the future for my career.

I'm easy to work with, quick to understand how scenes and presets are meant to be lay out and can work under intense pressure when needed / brought on.

I'm happy to work around the whole of the UK and abroad and I'm extremely flexible when working around dates and times that are needed.

Following previous tuition in drama through school, I have gained many skills throughout the past few years and I'm extremely confident to portray characters in ways given.

items.text:
🎬 LOOKING FOR ADVICE & OPPORTUNITIES 🎬
Hi everyone! I’m Keira, I’m 21 and from Cornwall, and I’m finally taking the leap and putting myself out there because acting is something I absolutely love and have always dreamed of pursuing. ❤️

I have some acting and performing experience, but I don’t have any formal acting qualifications or loads of professional experience. I’m basically at the beginning of my journey and trying to figure out the best way to get my foot in the door.

I’ve recently had some headshots taken and would love some honest opinions are they suitable for casting/Spotlight?

I’d also love advice from anyone in the industry. What route would you recommend for a 21 year old girl with some experience, no formal qualifications and a very big dream? 🎭

I’m open to casting opportunities, short films, student productions, workshops, auditions, agencies — anything that could help me build experience and get started.

I know I have lots to learn, but I’m genuinely willing to put the work in. I’m a little bit quirky, very enthusiastic and definitely not afraid of throwing myself into something 😂

If anyone has any advice, opportunities or knows someone I should speak to, I’d be incredibly grateful. ❤️ also please pm me if anyone has even the littlest help with anything at all or the right direction to go down ❤️

Everyone has to start somewhere  this is me starting. 🎬✨

topComments.text: Are these the headshots you mentioned? Did you pay??

Hi Keira!

Unfortunately these are not suitable headshots for Spotlight - they’re far too shadowy and you can’t see your face or your eyes very clearly. Have a search online for some actual headshot photographers; YellowBelly are very popular and potentially a good place to start to get an idea of what you need. There are some affordable companies out there as well; AKTA run a pay-what-you-can scheme and VRC Studios also have a regular offer for £100 headshot sessions too. 

I’d also assume from your post that without any professional acting experience, you’re unlikely to meet the criteria for a Spotlight membership at this stage in your career. Id really encourage looking into some acting classes and workshops near you if you can, just to keep those skills going. You could have a look at a paid Mandy subscription to find work for now and start building your experience. Groups like these are really good for casting opportunities. It may also be worth contacting your local universities if any of them have a film course as you could potentially find some work on student films. Best of luck to you

items.text:
**CASTING: MUSIC VIDEO | LOS ANGELES**

Looking for **dancers, performers, models, and party-goers** to be part of a Ghana-inspired music video filming this Sunday in Leimert Park.

We’re creating a vibrant celebration influenced by the music, movement, style, and energy of Ghana and the African diaspora, with a fun dance-floor atmosphere, freestyle moments, and opportunities for individuals and groups to be featured on camera.

**Professional dance experience is not required.** If you’re comfortable moving to Afrobeats, Hip Hop, and House music, have great energy, or simply know how to have a good time on the dance floor, we’d love to have you join us.

**Sunday, August 23**
**Call time:** 3:00 PM
**Location:** Leimert Park, Los Angeles
**Wardrobe:** Stylish/chic and comfortable to move in. Ghanaian, West African, and Afrocentric attire welcomed.
**Copy, credit + meal/refreshments provided**

Interested? Sign up here:
[https://forms.gle/f71R9kDZLAUGwsB38](https://forms.gle/f71R9kDZLAUGwsB38)

**Know someone who would be great for this? Tag them or share this post with them.**

[CALL FOR SCREENWRITERS] 🎬✍️

GM Film Production is actively seeking a talented and dedicated Screenwriter to collaborate on an upcoming feature film project titled "Born to Dominate".

We are looking for a writer who can deliver strong character arcs, compelling dialogue, and a powerful narrative structure.

Project Details:
Type: Feature Film
Production House: GM Film Production
Role: Screenwriter / Scriptwriter
Location: Open (South Africa)

How to Apply:
If you are interested or have a portfolio/samples of your previous work (treatments, short scripts, or feature samples), please submit your details directly to our production inbox:

📧 Email: gmfilmproduction.official@gmail.com
📌 Subject Line: Screenwriter Application - Born to Dominate

Please include:
1.A brief introduction of yourself.
2.Writing samples or a link to your portfolio.
3.Your contact details.

Serious candidates only. Let’s build something extraordinary together! 🚀🎥

#FilmIndustrySA #Screenwriters #SouthAfricanFilm #GMFilmProduction #BornToDominate #CastingCall #FilmJobs

CALLOUT FOR ACTORS!!
Fight Like A Girl! is back in Manchester! We’re performing three nights of short plays from 3rd - 5th December 2026 at 53Two in Manchester and we need a whole host of actors for these short plays! There will be between 20 and 30 roles available for all casting types so all welcome to apply!

To apply, please send an expression of interest to fightlikeagirltheatre@gmail.com by midnight on 14th September 2026 detailing any previous acting experience and what you could bring to the production. CVs and showreels more than welcome to be sent, but if you don’t have these don’t worry, no matter your experience all are encouraged to apply!

Fight Like A Girl! is inspired by the fights of brave women who have faced cancer and all profit raised goes to supporting cancer research. As such this is an unpaid opportunity. However you will receive my eternal gratitude and a friend for life!*

We’re also still accepting applications for directors until 7th September as well as script submissions until 31st August! You can get your tickets for the show at https://53two.online/show/6a7b2f954d974177cc33c688

*Or at least until the end of the production

#fightlikeagirl

@fightlikeagirltheatre

🎭 **AUDITION DATES ARE NOW OPEN IN SWINTON, MANCHESTER** 🎭

**Welcome to Marble Academy:**

**Where you receive a higher standard of acting training.**

If you possess a deep passion for acting and are committed to forging a professional career in the performance industry, you have found your ideal training ground. —welcome to 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐀𝐜𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐲, where you turn: “𝐈’𝐝 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐚𝐜𝐭” into “𝐈’𝐦 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐥 𝐜𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐞𝐫.”

 

Marble Academy is proud to be a **Spotlight-accredited drama school** and two-time consecutive winner of **‘Best Drama School Of The Year ’, **reflecting the high calibre of education and training provided here.  Designed to strip away bad habits and build strong, repeatable techniques for TV, Film, and Theatre.

Led directly by **Christian Le Feuvre**—a LAMDA-qualified actor and award-winning filmmaker—our tailored modules give you the practical skills needed to thrive in a competitive industry:
* 🎬 **Script Analysis & Characterisation:** Uncover deep subtext and embody characters authentically.
* 🎥 **Acting for Camera:** Master the subtle, intimate nuances required for screen performance.
* 🎭 **Audition Preparation:** Build the technical control and confidence required to walk into any audition room ready to impress.
* 📅 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧: Mondays, 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM
* 📍 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞: Swinton, Manchester

🌐 **Explore Student Testimonials & Reserve Your Audition:** [www.marbleacademy.co.uk](http://www.marbleacademy.co.uk/)

 

So, stop wishing for opportunities and start equipping yourself to capture them. Take the leap, book your audition slot today.

 

𝐃𝐎𝐍’𝐓 𝐁𝐄 𝐀𝐍 𝐀𝐂𝐓𝐎𝐑 𝐁𝐄𝐂𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐄 𝐘𝐎𝐔 𝐖𝐀𝐍𝐓 𝐓𝐎; 𝐁𝐄 𝐀𝐍 𝐀𝐂𝐓𝐎𝐑 𝐁𝐄𝐂𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐄 𝐘𝐎𝐔 𝐇𝐀𝐕𝐄 𝐓𝐎!

🎭 **AUDITION DATES ARE NOW OPEN IN SWINTON, MANCHESTER** 🎭

**Welcome to Marble Academy:**

**Where you receive a higher standard of acting training.**

If you possess a deep passion for acting and are committed to forging a professional career in the performance industry, you have found your ideal training ground. —welcome to 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐀𝐜𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐲, where you turn: “𝐈’𝐝 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐚𝐜𝐭” into “𝐈’𝐦 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐥 𝐜𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐞𝐫.”

 

Marble Academy is proud to be a **Spotlight-accredited drama school** and two-time consecutive winner of **‘Best Drama School Of The Year ’, **reflecting the high calibre of education and training provided here.  Designed to strip away bad habits and build strong, repeatable techniques for TV, Film, and Theatre.

Led directly by **Christian Le Feuvre**—a LAMDA-qualified actor and award-winning filmmaker—our tailored modules give you the practical skills needed to thrive in a competitive industry:
* 🎬 **Script Analysis & Characterisation:** Uncover deep subtext and embody characters authentically.
* 🎥 **Acting for Camera:** Master the subtle, intimate nuances required for screen performance.
* 🎭 **Audition Preparation:** Build the technical control and confidence required to walk into any audition room ready to impress.
* 📅 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧: Mondays, 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM
* 📍 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞: Swinton, Manchester

🌐 **Explore Student Testimonials & Reserve Your Audition:** [www.marbleacademy.co.uk](http://www.marbleacademy.co.uk/)

 

So, stop wishing for opportunities and start equipping yourself to capture them. Take the leap, book your audition slot today.

🎬 CASTING CALL – OFFIZIELLES MUSIKVIDEO „TITTEN & BIER“ 🍺☀️

Für das offizielle Musikvideo zur neuen Party-Single „Titten & Bier“ von Ricky Leroy suchen wir gut gelaunte Menschen, die Lust auf einen sommerlichen Drehtag voller Party-Atmosphäre haben.

Das Projekt:
Es handelt sich umein unabhängiges Low-Budget-Musikvideoprojekt. 

Daher können wir leider keinebranchenübliche Gage zahlen. Als Dank für deine Zeit erhältst du eine Aufwandsentschädigung von 75 €, kostenlose Getränke sowie dein persönliches Footage für Showreel oder Social Media.

Wen wir suchen:
Wir suchen Personenab 18 Jahren für eine ausgelassene Poolparty-Szene.

Wichtig: Alle Bewerber*innen müssen mindestens 18 Jahre alt sein. Vorerfahrung ist nicht erforderlich – gute Laune und Lust auf einen Drehtag stehen im Vordergrund.

Das erwartet euch:
🏖️ Sommerliche Poolparty-Atmosphäre
🎶 Musik, Tanzen und gute Stimmung
🍺 Kostenlose Getränke
💶 Snacks

Über den Song:
Mit „Titten & Bier“ liefert Ricky Leroy einen energie geladenen Party-Song im Mallorca- und Ballermann-Stil. Der Titel steht für Sommer, Feiern, gute Freunde und jede Menge gute Laune – mit eingängigen Beats, amerikanischem Akzent und einemAugenzwinkern.

👙 Bikini
🩱 Badeanzug
🩳 Badehose
😎 Sommerliche Party-Outfits

📍 Der genaue Drehort wird spätestens bis zum 10.08.2026

WARSZAWA | 24- 26 SIERPNIA | KRAKÓW | 30- 31 SIERPNIA | SZUKAM PROWADZĄCEJ DO NIETYPOWEGO PROJEKTU 🎥🌍

Wpadł mi do głowy jeszcze jeden projekt. Ostatni. Przynajmniej tak sobie obiecuję. 😏

Szukam dziewczyny/kobiety, która dobrze czuje się przed kamerą i chciałaby poprowadzić ze mną około godzinną rozmowę o podróżach.

Nie musisz być dziennikarką. Możesz być modelką, aktorką, twórczynią na Instagramie albo po prostu osobą z charakterem, ciekawością świata i umiejętnością prowadzenia dobrej rozmowy.

Pomysł? Bardzo prosty.

Siedzimy naprzeciwko siebie na podłodze. Kamera stoi między nami. Ty masz 10–15 pytań. Ja mam za sobą kawałek świata i trochę historii, których raczej nie znajdzie się w przewodnikach.

O czym możemy rozmawiać?

🇺🇬 o Ugandzie i spotkaniach, które zostają w głowie na długo,
🇨🇷 o Kostaryce,
🇲🇻 o życiu na lokalnych wyspach Malediwów i fotografowaniu rekinów,
🇦🇱 o pomieszkiwaniu w Albanii i mojej nauce albańskiego,
🇮🇹 o Włoszech i książce, którą o nich piszę,
🐻‍❄️ o dalekiej północy, niedźwiedziach polarnych i tym, czy naprawdę udało mi się któregoś zobaczyć,
🌍 o ludziach poznanych po drodze, dziwnych sytuacjach, wpadkach, strachu, zachwytach i podróżniczych anegdotach.

I o wszystkim, co pojawi się między jednym pytaniem a drugim.

Nie chcę wywiadu typu: „Ile krajów odwiedziłeś?”.
Chcę rozmowy, w której można się roześmiać, zdziwić, nie zgodzić, dopytać, przerwać mi i zadać pytanie, którego kompletnie się nie spodziewam.

Bardziej interesuje mnie osobowość niż CV.

🎬 nagranie: około 1 godziny
📍 Warszawa lub Kraków 
💰 500 zł za udział w nagraniu
🎥 + 1000 zł po przygotowaniu materiału i za zgodę na jego publikację

Jeśli czujesz, że umiałabyś usiąść naprzeciwko mnie i wyciągnąć ze mnie historie, których normalnie nie opowiadam - napisz w komentarzu, że jesteś zainteresowana.

Możesz też odezwać się na Messengerze albo bezpośrednio na mój podróżniczy Instagram

 @wycieczko.

Nie szukam idealnej prowadzącej.

Szukam takiej, przy której po dziesiątym pytaniu zapomnimy, że między nami stoi kamera. 🎙️

topComments.text: Zainteresowana

**CASTING CALL - SHORT STUDENT FILM - NON-UNION**

**Shoot Date: **Sunday Aug 23rd**, **2026

**Location: **East Vancouver, BC

**Compensation:** Non-paid (volunteer)

We're casting two middle-aged men and two middle-aged woman to be in our short film. 

**Synopsis: **They're bored, so they found something to do. Maya and Daniel have something to hide, and so do Sophie and Alex. Between secret meetings and charged innuendos, one secret binds them all together. 

## Roles:
1. **Maya (Female, 35-50): **Maya is the witty and introverted English teacher who is exceptionally good at her newfound talent, miming. 
2. **Sophie (Female, 35-50): **Sophie is the cool, calm and collected art teacher** **whose sharp as a whip. She's oftentimes bored, and is looking for something fun to do to spice up her life. (May have to smoke a fake cigarette)
3. **Daniel (Male, 35-50): **Daniel is the macho man. Think cool gym teacher with an ego. He enjoys teasing others and is a bit of a goof ball. 
4. **Alex (Male, 35-50): **Alex is an anxious chemistry teacher who DREADS keeping secrets. He is, however, determined to impress Maya with his skills. 

**Please submit your CV and reel to auditions@kyliehatton.com using subject line: FATAL ATTRACTION - (Role) - (Your name).**

**Communication done through email ONLY**

**Additional Info:**
* Information about rehearsal will be communicated to you
* Sophies role may have to smoke a fake cigarette

Looking forward to potentially working with you :)

**CASTING DO NOWEGO FORMATU TELEWIZYJNEGO**
## **MASZ 18–30 LAT LUB 60-70+? DAMY CI SZANSĘ PRZEŻYĆ COŚ ZUPEŁNIE NOWEGO.**

Powstaje **nowy profesjonalny projekt telewizyjny** oparty na prawdziwych ludziach, autentycznych spotkaniach i sytuacjach, których nie da się do końca zaplanować.

Szukamy **młodych dorosłych w wieku 18–30 lat oraz seniorów 60+/70+ z całej Polski**.

**Wyślij na adres: pascalproduction.lab@gmail.com**

Nie musisz być influencerem, aktorem ani mieć żadnego doświadczenia przed kamerą.

Wręcz przeciwnie — **najbardziej interesuje nas to, jaki/jaka jesteś naprawdę.**

**KOGO SZUKAMY?**

Kobiet i mężczyzn w dwóch grupach wiekowych:

**18–30 LAT**
**60-70+**

Szukamy bardzo różnych osób i bardzo różnych historii.

Możesz studiować, pracować, prowadzić własny biznes, być na emeryturze albo właśnie zastanawiać się, co dalej. Możesz mieszkać w dużym mieście, małej miejscowości albo na wsi.

Możesz kochać sport, podróże, muzykę, ogród, gotowanie, motoryzację, technologię, sztukę, gry, taniec, majsterkowanie, internet albo mieć zainteresowanie, którego kompletnie się nie spodziewamy.

Możesz być duszą towarzystwa albo introwertykiem. Mieć mnóstwo energii albo spokojnie obserwować świat. Mieć za sobą niezwykłą historię albo uważać swoje życie za zupełnie zwyczajne.

**Nie szukamy jednego typu człowieka.**

Najważniejsze, żebyś miał/miała **własną osobowość, ciekawość ludzi i gotowość na nowe doświadczenie.**

**O CO CHODZI?**

Tego na etapie otwartego castingu **nie chcemy jeszcze zdradzać**.

Możemy powiedzieć jedno:

**wybrane osoby zaprosimy do udziału w nietypowym doświadczeniu, w którym liczyć się będą prawdziwi ludzie, ich osobowości, reakcje, emocje i różne sposoby patrzenia na życie.**

Nie jest to casting aktorski. Nie będziesz odgrywać napisanej roli.

Interesuje nas **Twoja prawdziwa osobowość i to, co wydarzy się naprawdę.**

Szczegóły projektu przedstawimy osobom zaproszonym do kolejnego etapu castingu.

**CHCESZ SPRÓBOWAĆ?**

**Wyślij na adres: pascalproduction.lab@gmail.com**
* imię i wiek,
* miejscowość,
* numer telefonu,
* aktualne zdjęcie,
* kilka zdań o sobie i swoich zainteresowaniach,
* link do Instagrama / TikToka — jeśli korzystasz,
* krótki film nagrany telefonem (ok. 1–2 min).

Na filmie odpowiedz po prostu:

**Kim jesteś? Co najbardziej Cię wciąga? Co jest dla Ciebie ważne? I czego jeszcze chciałbyś/chciałabyś w życiu spróbować?**

Nie montuj. Nie przygotowuj przemowy. Nie próbuj być „telewizyjny/a”.

**Telefon, minuta lub dwie i Ty.**

Jeżeli przejdziesz pierwszy etap, skontaktujemy się z Tobą i opowiemy więcej.

A jeśli podczas czytania pomyślałeś/pomyślałaś o **swoim znajomym, przyjacielu, rodzicu, dziadku, babci, wnuku lub wnuczce** — wyślij mu/jej to ogłoszenie.

**Być może właśnie takiej osoby szukamy.**

**CASTING DO NOWEGO FORMATU TELEWIZYJNEGO**
## **MASZ 18–30 LAT LUB 60-70+? DAMY CI SZANSĘ PRZEŻYĆ COŚ ZUPEŁNIE NOWEGO.**

Powstaje **nowy profesjonalny projekt telewizyjny** oparty na prawdziwych ludziach, autentycznych spotkaniach i sytuacjach, których nie da się do końca zaplanować.

Szukamy **młodych dorosłych w wieku 18–30 lat oraz seniorów 60+/70+ z całej Polski**.

**Wyślij na adres: pascalproduction.lab@gmail.com**

Nie musisz być influencerem, aktorem ani mieć żadnego doświadczenia przed kamerą.

Wręcz przeciwnie — **najbardziej interesuje nas to, jaki/jaka jesteś naprawdę.**

**KOGO SZUKAMY?**

Kobiet i mężczyzn w dwóch grupach wiekowych:

**18–30 LAT**
**60-70+**

Szukamy bardzo różnych osób i bardzo różnych historii.

Możesz studiować, pracować, prowadzić własny biznes, być na emeryturze albo właśnie zastanawiać się, co dalej. Możesz mieszkać w dużym mieście, małej miejscowości albo na wsi.

Możesz kochać sport, podróże, muzykę, ogród, gotowanie, motoryzację, technologię, sztukę, gry, taniec, majsterkowanie, internet albo mieć zainteresowanie, którego kompletnie się nie spodziewamy.

Możesz być duszą towarzystwa albo introwertykiem. Mieć mnóstwo energii albo spokojnie obserwować świat. Mieć za sobą niezwykłą historię albo uważać swoje życie za zupełnie zwyczajne.

**Nie szukamy jednego typu człowieka.**

Najważniejsze, żebyś miał/miała **własną osobowość, ciekawość ludzi i gotowość na nowe doświadczenie.**

items.text:
🎬 ACTORS WANTED – SOUTH WALES
We’re casting for an independent comedy mockumentary set in a hidden magical village in the South Wales valleys.

The world is populated by magical and unusual characters, but we’re keeping the look deliberately grounded — think BBC-style comedy/fantasy rather than full cosplay. Slightly strange, homemade and believable is perfect.

Currently looking for:

• Digby Frogsprout – Male, 30+

• Maureen Moss – Female, 30+ 

*CURRENTLY IN DISCUSSION*

• A handful of extras for one episode, playing members of a jury

We’re looking for confident, reliable performers who are comfortable with comedy and a bit of improvisation.

📍 Filming primarily around the Merthyr Tydfil area.

Actors would need to source their own costume, but nothing expensive or elaborate is expected — we’ll work together on the character’s look using ordinary clothing and simple accessories.

Interested? Drop me a message and I’ll send over the character details and more information about the show. 🎥

# **BLIV EN DEL AF ONDT**

 

Til efteråret præsenterer **Teltet på Bakken** og **Dystopia Entertainment** horrorforestillingen **ONDT** – en ny, intens og anderledes teateroplevelse, hvor publikum træder direkte ind i fortællingen.

 

Vi søger nu frivillige medvirkende, der har lyst til at blive en del af et ambitiøst, professionelt  og kreativt fællesskab. Rollerne er ulønnede, men til gengæld bliver du en vigtig del af en professionel teaterproduktion og er med til at skabe noget, ingen har oplevet før.

 

Som medvirkende bliver du en del af et unikt kunstnerisk fællesskab, hvor frivillige medvirkende, professionelle skuespillere og instruktørerne **Henrik Grimbäck** og **Christina Neumann Jensen** sammen skaber ONDT – fra de første prøver til den sidste forestilling.

I **ONDT** er publikum ikke blot tilskuere – de befinder sig midt i forestillingen. Du bliver en del af det univers, der omgiver dem, og er med til at skabe de øjeblikke, de husker længe efter, de har forladt teltet.

 

Du behøver ikke have erfaring med teater. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde fysisk, være tæt på publikum og indgå i et stærkt ensemble, hvor alle bidrager til den samlede oplevelse.

 

**HVILKEN ROLLE PASSER TIL DIG?**

 

**WILDCARDET**

Kan du lidt af det hele? Du har god energi, lærer hurtigt og har lyst til at være en del af et stærkt fællesskab. Vi leder efter mennesker med nysgerrighed, engagement og lyst til at kaste sig ud i noget nyt.

 

**SNIGERNE**

Er du gymnast, parkourudøver, danser eller har du exceptionel kropskontrol? Du kravler, sniger dig og bevæger dig lydløst gennem mørket. Du er der, hvor publikum mindst forventer det.

 

**MONSTRENE**

Du har en stærk fysisk udstråling og tør bruge hele kroppen til at skabe frygt. Store bevægelser, intensitet og nærvær er vigtigere end replikker.

 

**LOKKEDUERNE**

Du ligner en helt almindelig gæst. Du griner, hygger dig og falder naturligt ind blandt publikum – indtil stemningen pludselig ændrer sig. Rollen kræver nærvær og troværdighed.

 

**OFRET**

Det hele begynder med dig. Du kan skabe ægte frygt og få publikum til at holde vejret. Rollen kræver nærvær, mod og evnen til at give sig fuldt ud.

Vi ønsker et mangfoldigt ensemble og opfordrer alle interesserede til at søge. Har du et særligt talent, en usædvanlig fysik eller en færdighed, som kunne passe ind i ONDTs univers, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

 

**INTERESSERET?**

Skriv til **[ondt@dystopia.dk](mailto:ondt@dystopia.dk)**

Fortæl lidt om dig selv, vedhæft gerne et billede, og skriv, hvorfor du har lyst til at blive en del af ONDT. Har du særlige færdigheder eller erfaring med bevægelse, dans, gymnastik, parkour, performance eller lignende, må du meget gerne fortælle om det.

 

**Senest d.14/8**

 

**FORLØBIG PRØVEPERIODE**

 

**August**
* 17., 20. og 27. august (eftermiddag/aften)

 

**September**

 
* 2., 9., 11., 15. og 16. september (eftermiddag/aften)
   1. september kl. 10.00–14.00
* Daglige prøver fra 20. september frem til premieren den 25. september.

 

**SPILLEPERIODE**

 

**25. september – 1. november 2026**

 

Se spilledage på:
**billet.cirkusrevyen.dk**

**Vi søger ikke bare medvirkende. Vi søger mennesker, der har lyst til at skabe noget helt særligt sammen med os.**

 

[[https://dystopia.dk/](https://dystopia.dk/)](https://dystopia.dk/)

CASTING CALL | FOURCE

ISO: RAPPERS, DANCERS & SINGERS
Fource is looking for two new members to join our global girl group.

AUDITIONS
Applicants must be 18+.
Submit your audition here:
https://forms.gle/TqzVJZ2rsbizgWQ77

ABOUT FOURCE
Fource is an independent global girl group based in the United States that follows the K-Pop system. We create and perform original music and choreography.
Our concept is centered around the five elements: Water, Earth, Fire, Air, and Spirit.
We are currently casting for the Air and Fire elements.

AIR ELEMENT
Personality: Bubbly, energetic, and “sunshine”
Preferred Vocal Range: Mid Alto to High Soprano
Preferred Role: Main Rapper / Main Dancer
Inspirations: Rei Ami, Tate McRae, Sabrina Carpenter, Lisa, Rosé, Yuki, Yeji, Rei
We are looking for someone with strong stage presence, versatility, charisma, and an energetic performance style.

FIRE ELEMENT
Personality: Confident, grounded, and charismatic
Preferred Vocal Range: Alto to Low Soprano
Preferred Role: Main Dancer
Inspirations: Manon of KATSEYE, JENNIE, Savanna of Girlset, Yeji, Alexa, Bailey Sok
We are looking for someone with strong dance ability, confidence, natural charisma, and commanding stage presence.

For questions, comment below or contact FourceBand@gmail.com.

We’re looking for dedicated performers who are ready to grow, create, and perform with Fource.

Currently unpaid but in process of payment options.

**URGENT LOS ANGELES CASTING — BLACK BOY, AGES 10–14**

Hey everyone, my name is Dayna Iniguez and I’m helping with casting for an independent short film, directed by Los Angeles filmmaker Reginald “Reggie” Hughes. We shoot **this Sunday, August 23**, so this is an **urgent casting search** trying to fill one remaining youth role. We are looking for a **Black boy around 10–14 years old **to play MAN-MAN, a small but pivotal supporting role.

**What we’re looking for:**
• Comfortable taking direction
• Acting experience is **not required**
• Parent/guardian involvement is required

**Compensation:** Unpaid
**Provided:** Meals, screen credit, and footage

This is a small independent narrative production with a professional crew, open to first-time performers. If you have a son, nephew, younger brother, cousin, student, athlete, or know **any Black boy ages 10–15 who may be interested**, please **tag/share this with their parent or guardian**.

Interested parents/guardians can **message me directly**, and I can connect you with Reggie and send over the script, character information, schedule, and full production details.

**Director:** Reginald “Reggie” Hughes
**Director's Portfolio:** https://www.reggiehughesportfolio.org/
**Director's Linkedin: **https://www.linkedin.com/in/reggie-hughes-38131a263/

**URGENT LOS ANGELES CASTING — BLACK BOY, AGES 10–14**

Hey everyone, my name is Dayna Iniguez and I’m helping with casting for an independent short film, directed by Los Angeles filmmaker Reginald “Reggie” Hughes. We shoot **this Sunday, August 23**, so this is an **urgent casting search** trying to fill one remaining youth role. We are looking for a **Black boy around 10–14 years old **to play MAN-MAN, a small but pivotal supporting role.

**What we’re looking for:**
• Comfortable taking direction
• Acting experience is **not required**
• Parent/guardian involvement is required

**Compensation:** Unpaid
**Provided:** Meals, screen credit, and footage

This is a small independent narrative production with a professional crew, open to first-time performers. If you have a son, nephew, younger brother, cousin, student, athlete, or know **any Black boy ages 10–15 who may be interested**, please **tag/share this with their parent or guardian**.

Interested parents/guardians can **message me directly**, and I can connect you with Reggie and send over the script, character information, schedule, and full production details.

**Director:** Reginald “Reggie” Hughes

**Director's Linkedin: **https://www.linkedin.com/in/reggie-hughes-38131a263/

topComments.text: Hi there! I’m not a casting agent, but I am a producer for a short film taking place here in LA (North Hollywood to be exact). Do you by chance speak/know any Russian? Or perhaps can portray a Russian accent? Let me know, I think you’d be perfect to audition. We film Sept 5th and 6th. lmk thanks!

Based on your post, the only experience you have is one background job, and whatever you did before to get the bug “again.”

But you don’t want basic info, because you’re not a “beginner.”  So what are you hoping to get from this post?  Insider information or an agent to want to sign you based on this post?   You want an agent to point you to which type of “others” in the business?  Other actors?  Filmmakers?

What exactly is it that you’re looking for that you don’t want “basic” info but also aren’t telling us anything about your experience and where you think “basic” ends in your perspective?

💫Famous Entertainment and Glimmer are searching for a female Musical Theatre vocalist who can dance for a festive residency at Woburn Forest, Center Parcs. 

💫 Rehearsals to be held in Warwickshire for 3 days on the 2nd, 3rd & 4th November 2026. Accommodation provided on the 2nd & 3rd. 

💫 Performance dates are as follows; 1st, 6th, 8th 13th, 15th, 20th, 22nd & 24th December.(Times TBC) 

* Fees are above equity minimum and we are searching for a singer from the Bedfordshire or surrounding counties. 

* Performers must have an ear for harmonies, star quality, dance experience and the ability to work well within a team. 

* Performers may potentially be asked to submit a self-tape or attend an audition if suitable for the role. Details TBC. 

🌟 Please email entertained@wearefamous.co.uk showreels and CV for consideration and state within the email whereabouts you are based and whether you drive. Please write in the subject line, ‘Glimmer Vocalist 2026’ 🌟

We look forward to hearing from you 💫 💫💫

Many Thanks. 

@glimmertrio 💫

** HEADSHOT SUNDAY **

It's Sunday, which means it's the one day I'm allowed to talk about this in here, so actors and models, listen up.

Your headshot is your first audition. Casting directors and agents are scrolling fast, and a blurry selfie or a five-year-old shot isn't getting you in the room. It's time to sort it.

I'm Khandie, Northampton-based photographer, and headshots are one of my things. Packages start from £99, and I mix studio and natural light depending on what you need: commercial, theatrical, character, self-tape thumbnail, the lot. Diverse packages built for a diverse industry, because one look doesn't cut it anymore.

If your Spotlight profile or your book needs an update, this is your sign.

Drop me a comment or message to get booked in — spaces fill fast on Headshot Sunday.

 Northampton

🎬 CASTING CALL — MEGAN
TV Series: BUDDIES

Role: Megan

Filming Dates: October 3rd & 4th

Location: Dallas, Texas 

Compensation: Unpaid / Non-Paid Role

Food Provided: Yes

Production Credit: Yes

ABOUT MEGAN

We are looking for a Black female actress to play Megan, a beautiful, confident social media influencer who knows exactly how to use her looks and personality to get attention.

Megan is attractive, stylish, confident, and has a strong social-media presence. She should naturally give off that “I know I’m bad” type of energy and be comfortable portraying someone who gets attention wherever she goes.

The role is comedic and requires someone who can be confident, playful, flirtatious, and natural on camera.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 • Black female actress

 • Attractive / camera-friendly

 • Confident and charismatic

 • Strong social-media influencer vibe

 • Comfortable with flirtatious and playful dialogue

 • Good comedic timing

 • Comfortable being on camera

 • Reliable and available October 3rd & 4th

Acting experience is preferred but not required.

COMPENSATION

This is a non-paid independent TV series production.

🍽️ Food will be provided during filming.

🎬 Production/screen credit will be provided.

topComments.text: DO NOT GET SCAMMED STAY FAR AWAY FROM IPOP OR ANYTHING THAT CHARGES MONEY. Start off with 1. Headshots . 2. Actors access and casting networks self submit locally and to places you know you can go to at the drop of a hat to agencies in those locations their website will give u info. Add local facebook groups about acting and local work. Go from there. Oh yes and classes I’d start with actors access. They will also help you get an agent eventually if you need it and a lot of their students book jobs and they’re affordable.

That’s a really tough age to start without any experience. She is about to enter the “dead zone” where even for experienced actors, bookings slow down. That being said, I’d say find her some acting classes in person or even virtual. She can learn the craft.

WE WANT YOU!!!!

Over the years we have started to build our group into a company that we’re really proud of and now, we’re inspired to take things further. We are looking for adults of all ages, genders and backgrounds to come and join us for our next adventure! We are happy to welcome people with all experience levels to join us, all we ask is for dedication and for you to enjoy yourself! 

The Cotham Theatre Company is a small and friendly amateur theatre group that meets on a Thursday evening from 7.30-9.30 at Cotham School. Our goal is simple - to play, explore and create through theatre. We believe in community, supporting each other and helping each other to reach our highest potential. Over the past four years we have produced four outstanding pieces of theatre, including tackling Shakespeare (Hamlet) and Marlowe (Dr Faustus), exploring more modern work (Dennis Kelly’s ‘DNA’) and in 2026 we took the plunge on an original play called Portraits of Ruin written by our Director, Sky Young, loosely based on The Picture of Dorian Gray. 

If you’re interested in joining us, please pop us a message on socials or email Sky Young at thecothamtheatrecompany@gmail.com

#amdram #bristol #bristoltheatre #amateurtheatre #actingclass

**CASTING CALL – Child & Adult Models | PAID**

I'm casting children and adults for **Round **Two of a** larger non-speaking product video project** featuring creative building toys. Non-union.

I'm currently building out my talent roster for this next phase, with filming expected to take place mid-to-late September in the Lower Mainland, BC.

**CURRENTLY CASTING**

**Group 5**
* Age 5–7, Female, Asian
* Age 8–11, Male, Asian

**Group 6**
* Age 6–8, Male, Hispanic
* Age 6–8, Female, Hispanic
* Mixed ethnicity / mid-skinned children may also be considered

**Group 7**
* Age 6–9, Female, Caucasian
* Age 6–9, Male, Black / dark-skinned

**Group 8**
* Age 5–7, Female, Caucasian
* Age 8–11, Female, Asian

**Group 9**
* Age 5–7, Male, Asian
* Age 8–10, Female, Asian

**Group 10**
* Age 5–7, Male, Black 
* Age 8–11, Female, Black
* Mixed ethnicity / dark-skinned children may also be considered

**Group 11**

Children:
* Age 5–7, Female, Caucasian
* Age 8–11, Male, Asian
* Age 8–11, Female, Mixed Ethnicity

Adults:
* Age 36–45, Male, Caucasian
* Age 25–35, Female, Asian
* Age 60+, Female, Mixed Ethnicity

We're looking for talent who are comfortable on camera and able to follow simple direction. For child roles, we're looking for kids who enjoy playing and interacting naturally with toys.

Previous acting or modelling experience is welcome, but **not required**.

**PROJECT DETAILS**
* Non-speaking roles
* Filming: Mid-to-late September
* Location: TBD-Lower Mainland, BC
* Pay: $50 CAD/hour with a 3-hour minimum guarantee ($150 minimum per person)
* Most talent will likely be needed for approximately 1–2 hours
* A parent or guardian must remain on set for all child participants

**IMPORTANT – USAGE & CONFIDENTIALITY**

This project is being produced under a strict client confidentiality clause. Finished videos will be used digitally across the client's Amazon, website, social media, and online advertising.

Finished videos and production materials cannot be provided to talent or used for portfolios, demo reels, social media, or personal use. **Please only apply if you are comfortable with these terms.**

**PREVIOUSLY SUBMITTED?**

If you have **already emailed me about your child for phase 1 of this project, you do not need to apply again.** I have your information on file and will be reaching out for this next phase if you or your child may be a fit for one of the roles.

**TO APPLY**

Please email **[runestonepics@gmail.com](mailto:runestonepics@gmail.com)** with:
* Group number(s) you're applying for
* Applicant's name, age, and gender
* A few recent photos (casual phone photos are perfectly fine)
* General availability in mid-to-late September
* Previous acting or modelling experience, if applicable

**Subject Line:** Group # – Age – Gender
Example: **Group 5 – Age 6 – Female**

If your child fits more than one group, feel free to include all applicable group numbers.

If you have two children who fit both roles within the same group, please include both children in one email and provide the requested information and photos for each child.

Selected applicants will be contacted with additional project details, filming dates, and required forms.

I'm currently building out my talent roster for this next phase, with filming expected to take place mid-to-late September in the Lower Mainland, BC.

* Age 8–11, Male, Asian

**Group 6**

We're looking for talent who are comfortable on camera and able to follow simple direction. For child roles, we're looking for kids who enjoy playing and interacting naturally with toys.

Previous acting or modelling experience is welcome, but **not required**.

**PROJECT DETAILS**
* Non-speaking roles

* Location: TBD-Lower Mainland, BC
* Pay: $50 CAD/hour with a 3-hour minimum guarantee ($150 minimum per person)

This project is being produced under a strict client confidentiality clause. Finished videos will be used digitally across the client's Amazon, website, social media, and online advertising.

Finished videos and production materials cannot be provided to talent or used for portfolios, demo reels, social media, or personal use. **Please only apply if you are comfortable with these terms.**

**PREVIOUSLY SUBMITTED?**

If you have **already emailed me about your child for phase 1 of this project, you do not need to apply again.** I have your information on file and will be reaching out for this next phase if you or your child may be a fit for one of the roles.

ATELIERS THÉÂTRE - ADULTES

Quand ?
Tous les samedis matins de 10h à 12h

Où ?
Au TNR, 3-5 rue Péan, 75013 Paris // Métro : Porte d’Ivry (Ligne 7)

Combien ?
180€ par trimestre + 10€ d’adhésion.
Il est possible d’avoir un tarif préférentiel selon votre coefficient familial (égal ou inférieur au QF4).

Le cours d’essai est gratuit !

Inscriptions, contactez Andréa : 06 32 07 69 48 // andrea.fulconis2@gmail.com

DESCRIPTIF

Le cours est ouvert à tous les adultes de 18 à 99 ans, désireux de rencontrer - ou de re-rencontrer - le théâtre.

- L’année sera divisée en deux parties - 

De septembre à décembre, nous travaillerons les outils du comédien par le biais d’exercices et d’improvisations (seul, à plusieurs, ou en collectif). Nous aborderons le corps et la voix de l’acteur, mais aussi son rapport à l’espace, à l’autre, au public, au silence... À travers cette recherche préliminaire, nous souderons le groupe. Le collectif sera notre maître-mot : c’est ensemble que l’on apprendra et que l’on grandira au plateau. L’objectif étant de monter une pièce ensemble durant la deuxième partie de l’année.

De janvier à juin, nous monterons, en effet, un spectacle à partir d’un texte d’auteur. Classique ou contemporain, comique ou tragique, nous trouverons l’auteur qui vous fait envie, la langue que vous voulez porter, l’histoire que vous voulez défendre ! Nous entamerons, alors, un travail précis d’interprétation du texte et de personnages, à travers une mise en scène crée sur mesure pour votre groupe. Un langage commun et une esthétique propre à la création nous rassemblera.

Plusieurs représentations sont prévues à la fin de l’année : nous jouerons notre pièce plusieurs fois devant un public bienveillant !

LA PROF - Andréa Fulconis

En parallèle d’un Master de Littérature Française à La Sorbonne, Andréa se forme aux Conservatoires d’Art Dramatique (CRD de Cannes, CRR de Nice et CRD de Bobigny). Puis, elle intègre l’École Internationale de Théâtre Jacques Lecoq, célèbre école de jeu corporel. Enfin, elle intègre la LUDI (Ligue Universitaire d’improvisation d’Île-de-France) et se perfectionne en improvisation.

Elle travaille, par la suite, pour plusieurs compagnies d’île-de-France en tant que comédienne, improvisatrice et metteuse en scène, comme Tonnerre de Singe, La Mazane ou Les Loups-Graou, qui sont tout autant d’espaces et des foyers de création lui permettant de développer sa recherche artistique.

La pédagogie prend également une place importante dans sa vie puisqu’elle est professeure de théâtre et d’improvisation pour la Cie Maya, la Ludo Impro’, La Mazane, et désormais au TNR, pour la Compagnie Tonnerre de Singe

Riche de toutes ces expériences, Andréa mêle, dans ses cours de théâtre, un travail précis de texte - hérité de sa formation classique - à une recherche vivante et corporelle, telle qu’elle s’en est emparée par la suite dans son travail artistique. Ses cours sont, pour elle, un espace de recherche à part entière, au même titre qu’une création professionnelle.

items.text:
🎙️ **Deutscher männlicher Sprecher / Creator für regelmäßigen YouTube-Kanal gesucht**

Ich suche einen **muttersprachlichen deutschen Sprecher** für einen neuen YouTube-Kanal über **Finanzbetrug, Wirtschaftsskandale, Ponzi-Systeme und außergewöhnliche Kriminalfälle**.

Die Videos werden meist ca. **25–40 Minuten** lang sein. Das fertige deutsche Skript wird von mir geliefert.

Gesucht wird:
* männliche deutsche Stimme
* natürliche, ruhige und spannende Erzählweise
* saubere Audioaufnahme
* zusätzlich eine einfache Videoaufnahme während des Sprechens

Das Video kann ganz unkompliziert mit dem **Smartphone** aufgenommen werden. Idealerweise seitlich bzw. im 3/4-Winkel, sodass Gesicht und Mund sichtbar sind. Professionelle Kamera oder aufwendige Videoproduktion sind nicht nötig.

Es geht um eine **regelmäßige Zusammenarbeit**.

💶 Budget für die ersten Folgen: ca. **30–50 € pro Episode**.
Auch Anfänger, Schauspieler, UGC-Creator oder angehende Sprecher sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

Bei Interesse bitte gerne eine kurze Sprachprobe oder einen Link zu bisherigen Arbeiten per PN schicken.

Beispiel für den gewünschten Stil / die Einbindung des Sprechers:
[https://youtu.be/R64LEScn3-Q?is=NozwUDMY1udxFFQZ](https://youtu.be/R64LEScn3-Q?is=NozwUDMY1udxFFQZ)

AUDITION PÅ HITMUSICAL 🎭 
Skuespillere, sangere, dansere og ensemble søges til genopsætningen af Musicalteatrets originale, anmelderroste og storsælgende thrillermusical fra 2019, “JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”, skrevet og instrueret af Rasmus Mansachs (skaberen af bl.a. “Vi maler byen rød: The Musical” og “Jeg tror det kaldes kærlighed: The Musical”). Vil du være med i en seriøs, dramatisk, chokerende, rørende og anderledes dansk teaterproduktion, hvor man bogstaveligt talt kommer helt ud over scenekanten? Tilmeld dig audition hos hovedstadsområdets største musicalforening nu: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Auditiondato: Lørdag/søndag d. 12.-13. september 2026.
Der søges: Ca. 50 skuespillere, sangere og/eller dansere i alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op (erfaring er ikke et krav) til de 14 bærende roller og ca. 30 personer til ensemblet.
Øveperiode: 8. oktober 2026 – 1. marts 2027.
Øvested: Teaterhuset Borgen på Frederiksberg.
Forestillingsdatoer: 3.-20. marts 2027.
Spillested: Folketeatrets Store Turnéscene i København.
OBS: Det er også muligt at tilmelde sig “kun” som danser eller ensemble uden sang/replikker, hvis man ikke ønsker at synge kor eller have replikker i forestillingen.
Musicalteatret er en teaterforening, og det er derfor ulønnet at medvirke på scenen.
Auditiontilmelding: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Musicalteatret præsenterer:
“JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”
Instruktør: Rasmus Mansachs
Sanginstruktør/korleder: Johnny Jørgensen
Koreograf: Anne-Cathrine Albæk
Manuskript: Rasmus Mansachs
Originalsange: Lars Rahbek Andresen & Rasmus Mansachs
